== Summary ==
[[Kendrick Summers]], Decipher's Gold Leader, on Decipher's Star Wars CCG "Rebel Leaders" page (March 1997). The page's image alt text reads "Kendrick Summers photo". Photographer: unknown. 144 × 136 px, the only size Decipher published.

== Source ==
* [http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/playeractivities/rebelleaders/index.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game: Rebel Leaders], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327211720/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/playeractivities/rebelleaders/index.html Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970328005930im_/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/playeractivities/rebelleaders/images/kendrick.gif kendrick.gif] (Wayback 28 March 1997; this file is that capture, SHA-256 b2afb954f77b31861dd7391ea0295e5418db0ab0fb14d5e598f90439c084828d; the 19 December 1996 www.decipher.com capture is the same file).

== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Kendrick Summers]].
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the low resolution Decipher published.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of him is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use.
* '''Copyright:''' Decipher Inc. Used under fair use for identification only.
